mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 83 degrees with beautiful clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, but keep in mind that the air quality index is currently 54, which is in the moderate range.

In city news, the design phase for the I Voted sticker contest for Verona students is now closed. The community will have the opportunity to vote on the top submissions between July 28 and August 7 to determine the winning stickers for the November election. Also, residents are reminded to inspect mailboxes for winter durability and review the Public Works policy regarding potential plow damage.

For your schedule, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia fun at both Hop Haus and Lake Louie, followed by more trivia and live music at Paddy Mac's on July 29.
In our weekly police report, an incident occurred on July 13 where a 36-year-old man was arrested for an O-W-I after a passerby reported his vehicle was stuck on a large rock.
Today is a great day to enjoy the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
